newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish charter airline Oasis suspends debt payments.
newsitem.headline: Spanish charter airline Oasis suspends debt payments.

text.p: Privately owned Spanish charter airline Oasis formally suspended debt payments on December 11, an airline official said on Thursday.
"We did this in order to continue operations," he told Reuters.
He could give no details of Oasis's debts, but said flight operations were continuing as normal.

Oasis has changed owners several times since its creation in 1986 but has always remained in private hands. It made a modest profit in the financial year to end October 1995 and operates a fleet of four leased McDonnell Douglas aircraft and an Airbus A310.
